chunks: Abān ibn ʿUthmān narrated from al-Ḥalabī that he said:
He said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Shall I mention the Imams عليهم السلام in the salat (prayer)?” He said: “Summarize them.”

key_terms.أَجْمِلْهُمْ: mention them collectively or in a summarized way
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةَ: the Imams, the divinely appointed leaders

ai.seo_question: Should the names of the Imams عليهم السلام be mentioned individually during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question posed to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about naming the Imams عليهم السلام during salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام instructs the questioner to mention them in a summarized manner, indicating brevity in that devotional context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1415 - Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Al-Halabi that he said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):

"Shall I mention the names of the Imams (as) during the prayer?"
Imam (as) replied: "Summarize them”.
